authorization: ORDEM018 F1(b), unidade delegada explícita após T/F4: P/F4 D1b, P/F5 sombra e acumulada; nenhuma evidência, Monte Carlo, F9 ou novo veredito.
beta_rule: ALPHA_FINE_CODATA_2018 * sqrt(e) at runtime, no fitted beta in TGL
prior: Historical uniform broad declared bounds; CAMB support smaller. No evidence or prior normalization computed; no silent renormalization.

covariance.SN: full STAT+SYS1701x1701 reduced by historical OR mask to1657x1657, symmetrized, including calibrator-cosmological correlations
covariance.cross_blocks: No cross-block covariance supplied: block factorization is historical INPUT
covariance.SH0ES_scalar: included only P4; absent P5 to avoid duplicating ladder

SN.M: Analytically profiled once in full selected covariance; no prior imposed
SN.accumulated: c/H0 integral[du/(E(u) A(u))], A=exp(beta*(Istar-I(u))); all cosmological redshifts must be below z*

numerics.distance: New direct Gauss-Legendre64 checked against128 at all archived theta before any fit and all minima afterward; independent alternative to original cumulative Simpson20001+interpolation, not asserted identical algorithm
numerics.linear_algebra: Cholesky whitening, equivalent to covariance inverse quadratic form; preserve historical symmetrization; stable profiled residual instead of subtraction of large scalar forms
numerics.table: Reuse own independently written T4 six-node degree5 separable Lagrange; reuse verified T4 table receipt, no new table holdout run
numerics.optimization: TRF least_squares; historical scaled coordinates (1,.0005,.005,.005), central Jacobian h=.001 scaled, xtol/ftol/gtol1e-12, max_nfev200; LCDM first, fixed beta and free start from LCDM minimum
numerics.uncertainty: inverse JtJ in physical coordinates, no chi2/dof rescaling
numerics.reuse: P5 LCDM fitted once because beta0 makes shadow and accumulated identical; reuse earlier T4 and SN-only receipts without rerunning those fits

tolerance_status: Engineering replication tolerances frozen before any P45 computation. Historic target values already read and declared; no new scientific discrimination thresholds.

resources.design_memory: Dense1701^2 input and1657^2 covariance/factor, discarded after initialization; no batches or chains

targets: Exact archived JSON paths, theta, chi2 blocks, K, H0, M, free beta/sigma and derived diagnostics; complete raw subobjects retained. P4 full LCDM theta not present, H0 and block minima still compared.
stop_rule: Source mismatch, support excursion, fixed-point or quadrature failure, optimizer failure or tolerance discrepancy -> preserve P45_RESULTADO and stop batch. Do not tune law or targets.
independence: Only new P45 implementation plus previously independent T4 helpers; original um.py, motor, backups and original helpers never imported/executed. Scientific originals read-only. No remote calls/new catalogs.
